svg.title: Ktemata r5 airbrush scheme - STRATA
svg.desc: Continuity: the stack is keyed to x, not to y, so each rail runs dead straight from the cover into the deck and the U closes across the hinge. 32 mm of bands fits inside the deck's 40.95 mm rail and the cover's 44.55 mm margin, so one set of masks serves both parts. The bands are interrupted only where the deck is cut (fan, screws, Pi opening) and where the cover's display well takes over - both masked, never touched up.
